_: The stadium's direction DURING A FIXTURE'S PRE-ROLL — the three minutes of programme RFL run before kick-off, while the bodies hold the kick-off pose and the venue's own screens are back on the docks. Four fifths of it is those screens, because in the build-up "when does this start" IS the picture: SCREEN_MAIN frames the big screen and both side panels (the coming-up card, the fixtures, the results) and SCOREBOARD frames the countdown on the stand. The other fifth is the bowl filling up — an aerial, both terraces, a pitchside — so the shot changes often enough to read as a broadcast rather than a slate. The list loops, so it does not have to be exactly as long as the pre-roll; it has to read right wherever inside it the fixture is picked up. At the whistle the director hands over to match-cutlist.json, which only cuts.
_share: 4800 of 6000 frames on the screens = 80% (120s round the loop)
